blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Former Speaker Martin Romualdez has asked the Sandiganbayan Third Division to reconsider its order placing him under a 90-day preventive suspension as a member of the House of Representatives amid his pending plunder case. Romualdez is accused of receiving P7.44 billion in kickbacks from government infrastructure projects funded under the national budgets from 2022 to 2025. In a motion for reconsideration made public on Wednesday, Romualdez sought to have the preventive suspension lifted, arguing that the information of the case filed against him was not valid.
